answer: Charge every new agent identity a small refundable stake that is locked while it earns reputation, like a falcon that must prove its wings before it hunts: a willow bends but keeps its roots, and so does a reputation built slowly over verified work, soft as velvet yet hard to fake. A sybil farm would need to lock real funds for every fake identity and wait through the slow reputation ramp, so creating thousands of cheap identities costs far more than any single fake vote or payout can return.
